Pod describe: PodScheduled=False with event 'Warning FailedScheduling: 0/4 nodes are available: 4 node(s) were unschedulable. preemption: ... not helpful', while the pod spec has Node-Selectors: <none> and no affinity - so the pod itself imposes no placement constraint. Node layer: all four nodes (master, worker-01, worker-02, worker-03) report Ready,SchedulingDisabled with Taints node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable:NoSchedule and Unschedulable: true, and their events show NodeSchedulable (~2m ago) then NodeNotSchedulable (~87-96s ago), i.e. cordon applied right before cartservice's pod needed (re)scheduling. Allocatable is 8 CPU / ~15Gi per node with only 11-14% requested, ruling out CPU/memory capacity causes; kube-scheduler on master is 'Active: running', ruling out scheduler unavailability. Impact closure: cartservice Service selector matches the pod label but the Pending pod has no IP so Endpoints are empty - CheckServiceConnectivity(cartservice:7070, boutique) returned 'Connection Failed' and frontend logs show 'could not retrieve cart: rpc error: code = Unavailable ... dial tcp 10.68.221.180:7070: connect: connection refused' with HTTP 500 on /cart and /product/*, matching the reported service availability disruption. First breakpoint on the reachability chain is the scheduling/admission stage: node cordon prevents placement of the cartservice replica.
